steps.label: compile checks
cmd: T="$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/debug"; [ -f "$T/libcsvcore.rlib" ] || { echo 'the workspace build did not produce the csvcore library (libcsvcore.rlib)'; exit 1; }; out=$(rustc --edition 2021 --crate-name chk --crate-type bin --extern csvcore="$T/libcsvcore.rlib" -L "dependency=$T/deps" -o chk __checker__/check.rs 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -E '^error'; echo 'the hidden checks do not compile against csvcore as built by the workspace: keep the library API and the stats module described in README.md'; exit 1; }
